### New
- **Settings window.** A gear button left of the volume (expanded mode), or "Settings…" in the tray menu, opens a small settings window with three tabs:
  - **Countries:** add or remove any country that has stations (about 220, with a search box). The country menu and the shuffle button use your list.
  - **Volume:** turn the lower volume during ads and during calls on or off, and pick 30%, 50% or 70% of the current volume. In sync with the tray menu.
  - **Update:** check for updates and see the answer right there, then update with one click.
- The gear shows a green dot when an update is waiting.

### Notes
- The settings window is created when you open it and destroyed when you close it, so it uses no memory in between.
- Flags for all countries are now included, which makes the download a little bigger.
